TV Tonight
timely.line: Reba McEntire's NBC sitcom Happy's Place, where she inherits her father's Tennessee tavern, returns tonight for season three with old co-star Melissa Peterman. The tavern is open again.

timely.label: Family Movie
timely.line: Wildwood, a fantasy movie from an acclaimed children's novel about a girl who heads into an enchanted forest to save her baby brother, is now in theaters. Siblings everywhere are taking notes.

timely.label: 20 Years Ago
timely.line: Twenty years ago today, Taylor Swift released her debut album, Taylor Swift, and became a rising country star. Feeling old yet?

timely.label: 25 Years Ago
timely.line: Twenty-five years ago today, Microsoft released Windows XP, one of its most successful operating systems ever. Somebody's grandpa still runs it.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri's Share the Harvest program wants 6,500 donated deer this year and dropped the fees to donate. Freezer full? Share the venison.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Old-school deer hunters say a big storm moving through may be your best shot all season at a big buck. Rain gear: the new lucky charm.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: After heavy rains, duck hunters should scout flooded fields holding ducks and hunt that shallow sheet water. Puddles were never this exciting.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: CIYTI light-up princess costumes are recalled because kids can easily reach the button batteries inside, which can cause serious injury if swallowed. Check the costume bin before Halloween.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Costway convertible high chairs are recalled because they have no built-in restraint, so a child can slip through between the tray and the seat. Worth a look at mealtime.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: BAMAMON LED finger light toys are recalled because kids can easily open the button battery compartments. Time to check the toy box.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad says his greatest joy is watching his wife parent their mini-me daughter and hearing her say, Can you just relax. What goes around comes around.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom says nobody warns you how awkward it is being a parent at a kid's birthday party, making small talk for hours. Bring snacks and an exit plan.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom says there are too many trunk-or-treats, and they've become a fast candy grab instead of a fun social event. The minivans are tired too.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes has an easy stuffed pepper soup with ground beef, bell peppers and rice in a tomato broth, ready in 45 minutes. All the flavor, none of the stuffing.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes has a mostly hands-off Crockpot chili with ground beef, beans, tomatoes and warm spices. The Crockpot does the work.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Mortgage rates took a big drop Friday, Oct. 23, because trouble for tech stocks pushed bond yields lower. Somebody's house hunt just got cheaper.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster says one of the most underrated ways to save money is living rural, where nobody keeps up with the Joneses. The Joneses are broke anyway.
